description: This file defines macros and inline functions for byte-swapping (endianness conversion) of 16, 32, and 64-bit unsigned integers, including constant-time macros and pointer-based variants, used in Linux kernel development.

methods.name: __fswab16
methods.description: Inline function to byteswap a 16-bit value, using architecture-specific implementation if available.

methods.name: __fswab32
methods.description: Inline function to byteswap a 32-bit value, using architecture-specific implementation if available.

methods.name: __fswab64
methods.description: Inline function to byteswap a 64-bit value, with special handling for 64-bit architectures or through 32-bit swaps.

methods.name: __fswahw32
methods.description: Inline function to perform word swap on 32-bit value.

methods.name: __fswahb32
methods.description: Inline function to perform high/low byte swap on 32-bit value.
